text:
olivia: Deploy-bot just flagged a compatibility issue for runtime v2.15 on canary. Model 'llama3q-quant1' shows KV cache checksum mismatches. Can we decide hold vs proceed?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Compatibility check: runtime v2.15 -> model 'llama3q-quant1' on canary failed KV cache validation (checksum mismatch). Suggested: add affected pools to runtime pinlist or rollback. See https://deploy/status/1991 for details.

marcus: Noted. Which canary pools are impacted? Any customer-facing errors yet?

olivia: Affects canary-gpu-1 and canary-gpu-2. No external incidents reported, but logs show token duplication and occasional context corruption.

sasha: If we pin those pools to v2.14, will that block the autobatching fixes in v2.15 that product expects?

deepa: Autobatching improvements are behind a flag. We can preserve those features in non-affected clusters. Pinning the two canaries is low-risk.

ben: +1 for pin + run longer regressions. Recommend TTL 24h and a clear rollback/forward plan.

olivia: Proposed steps:
1) Add canary-gpu-1, canary-gpu-2 to runtime pinlist for v2.14
2) Kick off extended regression suite (KV checks, token stability)
3) If reproduces, open runtime bug and schedule hotfix kernel patch
4) Notify customers if pin extends beyond 24h

marcus: I'll open a PR to update deploybot pinlist with reason + 24h window. Tagging @sasha for review.

sasha: Please include the model compatibility matrix link and the failing log snippet in the PR.

olivia: Log snippet pasted below: 
```
[2026-03-19T15:02:10Z] kv_cache: checksum mismatch model=llama3q-quant1 runtime=2.15 expected=abc123 observed=def456 pool=canary-gpu-1
[2026-03-19T15:02:10Z] generation: token_duplication count=3 context_len=512
```

deepa: I'm starting a local repro run on a small harness (g4-small). Will try to reproduce KV checksum mismatch.

ben: If you can reproduce, open an eng-runtime bug and assign to the kernel team. If not, we still keep the pin and gather more traces.

marcus: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/deploybot/pull/812 — adds pinlist entries for canary pools + 24h TTL + justification.

sasha: Reviewing now. Quick ask: include the CI regression job name so we can trace test failures.

deploy-bot: Pin applied: canary-gpu-1, canary-gpu-2 -> pinned to runtime v2.14. TTL=24h. Blocked runtime v2.15 rollout on those pools.

olivia: Thanks. Keeping this thread open for repro results and next steps. :eyes:

deepa: Reproduced locally. KV checksum mismatch consistent with canary logs. Opening runtime bug: https://tracker/redwood/BUG-424 (kernel mismatch on quantized attention path). Will add dumps and perf traces.

ben: Good work. After BUG-424 land, we can plan hotfix vs rollback. For now, pin stands.

sasha: LGTM on the PR — merged once CI green.

olivia: Merged and deploybot confirmed pin application. Will update if pins need extension. :thumbsup:
